verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee mostly hands results straight back in open formats: HTML, JSON from extract_rules, and markdown via return_page_markdown. Its official CLI lists 'exports' among its functions, and a Usage API exposes account usage data. Nothing documents a full account-data export or an offboarding path. missing for 10: documented export of all account data (job history, schedules, settings), details of the CLI export formats and scope, and independent confirmation of data portability or a clean exit.
